title: Naturally Roasted Uruguayan Rhubarb Roast
description: A nutty and juicy Uruguayan dish featuring rhubarb, perfect for a date night, made in a copper pot. This roast is a delicious and unique meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef roast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a copper pot over medium high heat.
Sear the beef roast until browned on all sides.
Add the garlic, red wine, and beef broth to the copper pot.
Cover the copper pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the beef for 2 hours, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the rhubarb to the copper pot and continue to roast for an additional 30 minutes.
Remove the copper pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Slice the beef roast and serve it with the roasted rhubarb.
